name: Coastal Surveillance and Interdiction
mission_theme: Night coastal strip: perimeter patrol against small craft, interception under degraded link, sea-state limits.

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Perimeter patrol and intrusion response at PERIM-COAST (sector S3)
tasks.brief: Patrol the closed perimeter PERIM-COAST at 90 m, one UAV per assigned sector, and log a complete loop every 240 s. An intruder will enter from sector S3; detect it within 45 s, identify it (hover >= 5 s within 60 m) and shadow it while it stays within 400 m of the perimeter. Do not leave the geofence while chasing.
tasks.objective: Keep a continuous patrol of PERIM-COAST at 90 m, detect an intrusion entering at sector S3 within 45 s, identify it positively and shadow it inside 400 m of the perimeter.

actions: assign one UAV per sector with overlap
hand the track to the nearest UAV

constraints: minimum altitude 90 m - 20 m
no pursuit outside 400 m
failure_conditions: perimeter left uncovered for more than 120 s
geofence breach during the pursuit
intruder never detected

checkpoints.name: Patrol continuity
checkpoints.metric: perimeter length covered per loop and loop period
checkpoints.target: >= 90% of the perimeter each loop, period <= 240 s

checkpoints.name: Detection latency
checkpoints.metric: time from intrusion to first detection report

checkpoints.name: Positive identification
checkpoints.metric: hover time within 60 m of the intruder
checkpoints.target: >= 5 s hover and ID record submitted

checkpoints.name: Shadowing
checkpoints.metric: intruder distance from the perimeter while shadowed
checkpoints.target: intruder never beyond 400 m unshadowed for > 20 s

checkpoints.name: Patrol resume
checkpoints.metric: time to restore the abandoned sector

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Track 3 moving targets in AREA-SMUGGLER (10 min)
tasks.brief: 3 vehicles move inside AREA-SMUGGLER. Keep every target under continuous observation for 10 min from no closer than 100 m and no further than 400 m. When a target crosses into another UAV's sector, hand it over so that no track is lost for more than 10 s. Report target count and positions every 30 s.
tasks.objective: Track 3 independent ground targets inside AREA-SMUGGLER for 10 min, keeping each target locked for at least 90% of the time and handing targets between UAVs without losing track.

actions: assign primary and backup observed per sector
confirm the receiving UAV has the lock

constraints: no target identification reveal before classification is complete
no descent below 50 m over the track area
failure_conditions: two or more targets lost at the same time
entering the 100 m standoff of any target
UAV-UAV separation warning

checkpoints.name: Acquisition
checkpoints.metric: time until all 3 targets are locked

checkpoints.name: Per-target continuity
checkpoints.metric: fraction of 10 min with each target locked

checkpoints.name: Standoff window
checkpoints.metric: distance to tracked targets

checkpoints.name: Handoff quality
checkpoints.metric: track gap during sector handoff

checkpoints.name: Safety
checkpoints.metric: separation between tracking UAVs

tasks.title: Search and rescue sweep of AREA-TRAWLER (sweep 100 m, beacon in C2)
tasks.brief: A distress beacon is active somewhere in AREA-TRAWLER. Sweep the area cooperatively at 80 m with 100 m spacing between tracks so that at least 95% of the area is observed once. When a UAV detects the signal, localise it to within 20 m, mark the spot (hover >= 10 s and transmit the position) and hand the position to the rescue element. Do not leave uncovered strips when the first detection happens.
tasks.objective: Sweep AREA-TRAWLER with 2 UAVs at 80 m using a 100 m sweep width until the distress beacon is detected, localised to within 20 m and marked.

actions: report the beacon to the team

constraints: minimum separation 20 m
no flight inside the marked danger radius before the rescue element arrives
failure_conditions: beacon not detected within the window
marked position error above 40 m
abandoning the sweep to chase a false signal

constraints: hover only at declared capture points

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-SHORE (85% target, 2 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-SHORE completely. Fly parallel tracks at 80 m AGL with 20 % side overlap and keep every UAV 20 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 85 %. Recover to LZ-LIGHTHOUSE when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-SHORE with 2 UAVs at 80 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 85 % of the block with 20 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap

constraints: minimum separation 20 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task

tasks.title: Grid sampling of GRID-ROCKPOOL (12 points, revisit every 10 min)
tasks.brief: Sample the 12 points of the GRID-ROCKPOOL grid with the IR sensor. Every point needs at least 2 samples, taken 10 +/- 2 min apart, and each sample must be geotagged within 5 m. Plan the order so that the revisit interval is respected without waiting on the ground.
